entities.name: Monster Life in the Geffen Area

1.original_instruction: When you first arrive in Morroc (south Kafra), walk to the right until you see an Inn building (morocc 199,64). Go into the right portal, and talk to Old Scholar Tyus, Sir Chilias'Tyus (morocc_in 116, 101) and he'll tell you he is waiting for someone. He will talk about the Eye of Hellion. You find out he has completed a device that can seal the jewel's evil energy. Sadly, he doesn't know the whereabouts of the jewel. He asks you to find people that have accepted his assignment. Starting from Prontera you need to find Craine Hefron.
1.short_ru: Поговорите с Old Scholar Tyus в morocc_in 116, 101.
1.short_en: Talk to Old Scholar Tyus at morocc_in 116, 101.
1.full_ru: В Morroc у южной Kafra идите вправо до гостиницы (morocc 199,64). Войдите в правый портал и поговорите с Old Scholar Tyus, Sir Chilias'Tyus (morocc_in 116, 101). Он ждёт кого-то и расскажет об Eye of Hellion. У него готово устройство для запечатывания злой силы камня, но сам камень он найти не может. Он попросит разыскать прежних исполнителей поручения: начните с Prontera и Craine Hefron.

Go into the right portal, and talk to Old Scholar Tyus, Sir Chilias'Tyus (morocc_in 116, 101) and he'll tell you he is waiting for someone. He will talk about the Eye of Hellion. You find out he has completed a device that can seal the jewel's evil energy. Sadly, he doesn't know the whereabouts of the jewel. He asks you to find people that have accepted his assignment. Starting from Prontera you need to find Craine Hefron.

2.original_instruction: Find Clanux Heffron in Prontera (prontera 269 326) behind the church and tell him your intentions, He wants me to help you. Craine that show you what he have collected so far... a broken sword and a wheel. "Where did you find it?" you ask. He tell you the sword found from old Swordman's Association.
2.short_ru: Поговорите с Clanux Heffron в prontera 269 326 о находках.
2.short_en: Talk to Clanux Heffron at prontera 269 326 about the findings.
2.full_ru: Найдите Clanux Heffron за церковью Prontera (prontera 269 326) и объясните, что он отправил вас помочь. Craine покажет собранное: сломанный меч и колесо. Спросите «Where did you find it?»: меч найден у old Swordman's Association.
2.full_en: Find Clanux Heffron in Prontera (prontera 269 326) behind the church and tell him your intentions, He wants me to help you. Craine that show you what he have collected so far... a broken sword and a wheel. "Where did you find it?" you ask. He tell you the sword found from old Swordman's Association.

3.original_instruction: Near the old Swordman's Association you find a strange hole in one of the Training Puppet (prontera 224 80). | There are some writings on it: Veggie Lady N9 W3 BINGO!
3.short_ru: Осмотрите Training Puppet в prontera 224 80 и запомните Veggie Lady N9 W3 BINGO!

4.original_instruction: Go back to Clanux Heffron and tell him what you found. Then he gives you a Cogwheel that he found inside the Item Shop.

6.original_instruction: Head to the Item Shop where Craine told you and find an Unknown Machine near the Item NPC. It seem the machine is some sort of a wheel so, place the Cogwheel in it. Then the machine ask you to enter the numbers: 3847147298 ( Or 16754213). A shining slate comes out of the machine, the first Piece of Slate, the Prontera Tablet . Go back to Clanux and only tell him a little bit.
6.short_ru: Вставьте Cogwheel в Unknown Machine и введите полученный код; возьмите Prontera Tablet.
6.short_en: Put Cogwheel in Unknown Machine and enter the received code; take Prontera Tablet.

7.short_en: Return to Tyus and learn about Grout'he Tuccok in Payon.
7.full_ru: Вернитесь к Tyus. Он объяснит, что густой лес на плите означает Payon, и попросит найти там Grout'he Tuccok.
7.full_en: Go back to Tyus and he tells you the dense forest written in the slate refers to Payon . He asks you to look for Grout'he Tuccok there.

8.original_instruction: Meet Grout'he Tuccok in Payon (payon 182 132) and he's willing to cooperate if you pay 10k to buy his clues item. He gives you a Stone Heart , Green Herb , Grape Juice & Skirt of Virgin . He'll divulge the location he found those items one at a time. (Marks on the mini map. Try not to teleport or enter portals) | The first item is the Skirt of Virgin near the Resting Place (102,192). (You need to click on the wooden floor in the gazebo for the clue to pop out.) | The second is Stone Heart the hide inside Stone Pile (80,110). | The third for Green Herb is found in the Dried Fish (238,54). | The fourth Grape Juice is inside the Vat, across the wall (233,159).
8.short_ru: Заплатите Grout'he Tuccok в Payon 10k и последовательно осмотрите отмеченные места.
8.short_en: Pay Grout'he Tuccok in Payon 10k and inspect the marked places in order.
8.full_ru: В Payon встретитесь с Grout'he Tuccok (payon 182 132). За 10k он согласится продать подсказки и даст Stone Heart, Green Herb, Grape Juice и Skirt of Virgin. Он покажет места находок по одному, отметив их на мини-карте; старайтесь не телепортироваться и не входить в порталы. Первая подсказка, Skirt of Virgin, находится у Resting Place (102,192): нажмите на деревянный пол беседки. Вторая, Stone Heart, спрятана в Stone Pile (80,110). Третья, Green Herb, связана с Dried Fish (238,54). Четвёртая, Grape Juice, находится в Vat за стеной (233,159).

9.original_instruction: Go back to Grout'he and report to your findings. You try to solve the puzzle together. Then you find that if we link the locations in the minimap, there is a new location in the center of the city more specifically: the Wooden Floor (159,129), specifically the wooden floor of the porch in front of the house Grout'he mentions ( not inside the house). Go to the spot and find message left by Tyus.

10.original_instruction: Tell him about the hidden message you found and Grout'he thinks the next clue might be in the big stone statue in Archer Village to the north of Payon.

10.full_en: Tell him about the hidden message you found and Grout'he thinks the next clue might be in the big stone statue in Archer Village to the north of Payon.

11.original_instruction: Walk near the Statue of Buddha (pay_arche 135 31) in the lower right corner, the Piece of Slate starts glowing as if it is reacting to something powerful. Click on the Buddha Statue and suddenly the Statue of Buddha talks in your mind. He asks you a question. Choose "I won't kill, but I'll find a way to live!" A small opening appears below the statue and you get the second Piece of Slate, the Payon Tablet . | If you choose wrong, you will be killed (no exp loss.)
11.short_ru: У Statue of Buddha в pay_arche 135 31 выберите «I won't kill, but I'll find a way to live!».
11.short_en: At Statue of Buddha in pay_arche 135 31, choose “I won't kill, but I'll find a way to live!”.
11.full_ru: Подойдите к Statue of Buddha (pay_arche 135 31) в нижнем правом углу. Piece of Slate начнёт светиться. Нажмите на Buddha Statue: Statue of Buddha мысленно задаст вопрос. Выберите «I won't kill, but I'll find a way to live!». Снизу откроется отверстие, и вы получите вторую Piece of Slate — Payon Tablet. При неправильном ответе персонаж погибнет, но без потери опыта.

"Where is the abode with a shining silver roof that is mentioned in the third part of the balld of Grimnir?" You tell him Valaskjalf and he gives you the 4th Piece of Slate, the Geffen Tablet .

18.original_instruction: Welshyun will use the Blue Gemstone you gave him and then combine the 4 Pieces of Slate into a Complete Tablet . Shawn will tell you the Slate belongs to Hellion Revenant and he can send you to the location indicated in the Slate, and he sends you to the Sealed Cave ( gef_fild09 ). The entrance to the cave is a black area in the cliff as you walk west from where you are warped. The Hellion Revenant is a boss-type monster and walks fast. Hellion Revenant uses magic attacks frequently. You cannot use teleport or flywings inside the cave area so if you encounter Hellion Revenant, it will be a fight to the death. | You can complete the quest now by going back to Tyus in Morroc without killing Hellion Revenant.
18.short_ru: Соедините плиты у Welshyun; бой с Hellion Revenant необязателен для завершения.
18.short_en: Combine the tablets at Welshyun; fighting Hellion Revenant is optional for completion.
18.full_ru: Welshyun использует отданный ранее Blue Gemstone и соединит 4 Pieces of Slate в Complete Tablet. Shawn скажет, что Slate принадлежит Hellion Revenant, и отправит вас к Sealed Cave (gef_fild09). Вход — тёмный участок скалы к западу от точки переноса. Hellion Revenant — быстрый монстр типа boss, часто применяющий магию. В пещере нельзя телепортироваться или использовать flywings, поэтому столкновение с Hellion Revenant может закончиться боем до смерти. Можно завершить квест уже сейчас: вернитесь к Tyus в Morroc, не убивая Hellion Revenant.
18.full_en: Welshyun will use the Blue Gemstone you gave him and then combine the 4 Pieces of Slate into a Complete Tablet . Shawn will tell you the Slate belongs to Hellion Revenant and he can send you to the location indicated in the Slate, and he sends you to the Sealed Cave ( gef_fild09 ). The entrance to the cave is a black area in the cliff as you walk west from where you are warped. The Hellion Revenant is a boss-type monster and walks fast. Hellion Revenant uses magic attacks frequently. You cannot use teleport or flywings inside the cave area so if you encounter Hellion Revenant, it will be a fight to the death. | You can complete the quest now by going back to Tyus in Morroc without killing Hellion Revenant.

items.evidence: Head to the Item Shop where Craine told you and find an Unknown Machine near the Item NPC. It seem the machine is some sort of a wheel so, place the Cogwheel in it. Then the machine ask you to enter the numbers: 3847147298 ( Or 16754213). A shining slate comes out of the machine, the first Piece of Slate, the Prontera Tablet . Go back to Clanux and only tell him a little bit.

items.evidence: Walk near the Statue of Buddha (pay_arche 135 31) in the lower right corner, the Piece of Slate starts glowing as if it is reacting to something powerful. Click on the Buddha Statue and suddenly the Statue of Buddha talks in your mind. He asks you a question. Choose "I won't kill, but I'll find a way to live!" A small opening appears below the statue and you get the second Piece of Slate, the Payon Tablet . | If you choose wrong, you will be killed (no exp loss.)

locations.evidence: When you first arrive in Morroc (south Kafra), walk to the right until you see an Inn building (morocc 199,64). Go into the right portal, and talk to Old Scholar Tyus, Sir Chilias'Tyus (morocc_in 116, 101) and he'll tell you he is waiting for someone. He will talk about the Eye of Hellion. You find out he has completed a device that can seal the jewel's evil energy. Sadly, he doesn't know the whereabouts of the jewel. He asks you to find people that have accepted his assignment. Starting from Prontera you need to find Craine Hefron.

reviews.detail: Tyus/Tyrus and Clanux/Craine variants are same-guide return references, not silent corrections of verified game names. Shawn appears only during warp prose and is not proven to be Welshyun; keep the actor unresolved.

One gem is requested, delivered at 16 and used by the NPC at 18, not two player costs. Ten-thousand Zeny is one clue purchase. Payon clue items are given once; inspections are not a second inventory set. Wrong-choice White Potion is conditional.

Stage 18 explicitly permits completion without killing. Higher reward note accepts an already-held eye after cave entry; do not infer a kill flag, mandatory personal kill or fixed eye count. Final item quantities are not printed and remain NULL.

Machine codes are source alternatives linked to the received value, not a two-entry sequence. Four named tablets stay distinct from generic Piece of Slate and narrative Jewel of Hellion. Exact spellings/map labels are retained, including Geffen Dungeon Level 2 with gef_dun03. Some quoted answers have no printed choose/type method.
